paper_title: The Safety Reminder A Soft Prompt to Reactivate Delayed Safety   Awareness in Vision-Language Models
caption: The proportion of harmful responses in which the model showed a rejection tendency.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between input length and the harmful refusal ratio for different vision-language models on different datasets. The x-axis is labeled “Input Length” and has a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024, with tick labels at each value. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful Refusal Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. 

The line representing LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep is blue, marked with circular symbols, and is solid. It begins at approximately 0.23 at an input length of 128 and increases to about 0.33 by an input length of 1024, with a relatively constant trend between 256 and 512 where the value is approximately 0.28. 

The line representing Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep is orange, marked with square symbols, and is solid. It starts at approximately 0.16 at an input length of 128, rises to 0.25 at 256, remains at around 0.25 until 512, then increases to 0.33 at 1024. 

The line representing LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench is green, marked with triangular symbols, and is solid. It begins at 0.08 at an input length of 128, rises sharply to 0.24 at an input length of 256, then shows a slight increase to 0.28 at 512, and continues to about 0.32 at 1024.

The line representing Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench is red, marked with diamond symbols, and is solid. It begins at approximately 0.21 at an input length of 128, rises to 0.31 at 256, then to 0.38 at 512, and further increases to 0.43 at an input length of 1024.
